proc audioEnabled=(decoder: Decoder; enabled: bool) {....raises: [MpegError],
    tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Enables audio decoding; disable unused streams to avoid buffering them. Source   Edit   
proc close(decoder: Decoder) {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Releases a decoder immediately; repeated calls are harmless. Source   Edit   
proc decodeAudio(decoder: Decoder; frame: var AudioFrame): bool {.
    ...raises: [MpegError], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Decodes into reusable interleaved stereo floats; false leaves it unchanged. False means end of stream, a disabled stream, or undecodable data. Source   Edit   
proc decodeVideo(decoder: Decoder; frame: var VideoFrame): bool {.
    ...raises: [MpegError], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Decodes into a reusable owned RGBA buffer; false leaves it unchanged. False means end of stream, a disabled stream, or undecodable data. Source   Edit
